svg.text: Secondary pages at phone size. Same calm rules: one thing per screen, plain words, actions in thumb reach.

g.text: Sign in to see your swings.
Your swings are private to you.

text.tspan: Email and password. Nothing else needed.

g.text: That email already has an account.

text.tspan: You can delete your account and every swing
from the Account page at any time.

g.text: 7 steps · about a minute to read
Whole body and club in frame

text.tspan: Keep the feet and the club head in the
picture from address to finish. If the
feet are cut off, AIcoach cannot measure
the hips or posture.
No guess this time. Three things got in
the way, and each has a fix.

g.text: AIcoach reads only down the line, from behind.
Hips and posture need the whole body.
No result was made. Nothing was saved.

text.tspan: None of the three faults AIcoach checks
crossed its threshold. That is a real
answer, not a missing one.
Weight appears to move toward the
trail side at the top.

g.text: 5 saved swings · only you can see them
Swipe a swing left to delete it.

text.tspan: Moving the right way, still over the
threshold. Keep the wall drill going.

g.text: Both analyses stay attached to their clips.

text.tspan: Removes every analysis, result, key frame
and saved clip. You will not be able to
sign in.
Removes every analysis, result, key frame
and saved clip. You will not be able to
sign in.
This removes 9 analyses with their
results and key frames, and 5 saved swing
clips. It cannot be undone, and you will
not be able to sign in again.
